responsibility: Implements the mutable coordination object shared by the Resolver2_0 passes. This file wires together the per-namespace ForeverStack instances for values, types, macros, and labels; dispatches generic insert and shadowable-insert requests to the correct namespace; manages scoped push/pop operations across one or all namespaces for lexical traversal; and records resolved usage-to-definition pairs that later lookups and consumers can query.
same_name_distinction: Implements NameResolutionContext’s operational methods, dispatching inserts to the appropriate namespace ForeverStack, managing scoped push/pop across one or all namespaces, and storing resolved usage mappings; the paired header defines the context object, its owned namespace stacks, and the API surface.
